hooks.before:init: echo "[calver] governance cycle target = $(date -u +'%Y.%m') — scheme: CalVer YYYY.0M (see docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md and scripts/release-it-calver.mjs). CalVer owns the version; conventional-changelog only writes CHANGELOG.md."
hooks.after:release: echo '[release-herald] Cycle ${version} stamped. This is the seam for the release-communication step: hand CHANGELOG.md + the GitHub release notes to skills/reporting/release-herald.md to draft a per-cycle currency digest (feature highlights + governance provenance + a LinkedIn/social post) for HUMAN APPROVAL. No auto-posting happens here — this echo is a deliberate stub, not a real poster.'
